name: app-project-result-gradient-percent-bars-slide
title: Project Result with Gradient Percent Bars
whatItIs: A light grey slide titled Project Result with a two-tone headline about smart health tracking, a faint brand mark watermark, and three rounded gradient bars in orange, blue and purple with percentages and pill labels.
whatItMeans: Soft fading gradient bars and pill labels make results friendly, and each colour is tied to its metric.
techniques: Bars that fade from colour to transparent at the base
Pill labels in matching colour under each bar
Arrow above each value with the percentage

vocabulary.definition: A bar whose colour fades toward its base.
A coloured label naming a metric.
Words separated by dots beside a slide title.
